card.name: NYC311 2025 municipal descriptor baseline
card.description: Real NYC311 structured English issue descriptors from calendar year 2025, mapped to six CivicBridge categories. One example per cleaned descriptor; these are not free-form citizen narratives or individual service requests.
card.license: NYC Open Data reuse policy and Terms of Use (not a CC0 designation)
card.algorithm: Complement Naive Bayes · words-and-characters · training-only cross-validation

selection.method: Five-fold stratified cross-validation on training descriptors only

card.limitations: English NYC municipal descriptors only. Taxonomy mappings are project-authored, not independently reviewed labels. Descriptor-disjoint held-out scores do not establish accuracy on Indian citizen narratives, Hindi, or unsupported categories. Repeated template wording may remain. Scores are uncalibrated; human review is required.
